name: Pumpkin Rice Pudding

ingredients.name: whole milk, plus more for finishing
ground cinnamon, plus more for serving
cooked long-grain white rice, such as basmati or jasmine

instructions.primary_message: In a 3 to 4-quart saucepan, whisk together 4 cups milk, maple syrup, cinnamon, salt, ginger, and nutmeg. Stir in rice. Bring mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, then immediately lower heat to a simmer. (Watch mixture carefully to prevent milk from boiling over.) Cook, stirring and scraping bottom and sides of pot every few minutes with a rubber spatula to prevent sticking and scorching, adjusting heat as needed to maintain gentle bubbling, until mixture is thickened and creamy, 40 to 45 minutes.

Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, add pumpkin puree. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until pumpkin puree appears drier, slightly darkens in color, and is reduced to about 2/3 cup, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool while rice mixture finishes cooking.

Once rice is cooked, whisk pumpkin puree and vanilla into rice mixture until well combined. Adjust consistency with additional milk, if desired. Immediately divide among serving bowls and top with cinnamon, candied pecans, pepitas, and/or crushed cookies. Alternatively, allow rice pudding to cool completely before serving, adjusting consistency with additional milk as needed, then top with garnishes.

schema_metadata.keywords: rice pudding, pudding, pumpkin pudding, pumpkin rice pudding

description: A creamy pumpkin rice pudding made with warm spices, whole milk, and cooked rice for a cozy fall dessert.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Chopped candied or toasted pecans, pepitas, and/or crushed speculoos cookies, for serving

Notes: If a thicker, more cohesive texture is desired, use medium-grain rice, such as Calrose.
Homemade pumpkin puree may be used in place of store-bought.

Make-ahead and storage: Rice pudding can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 5 days. The pudding will thicken in the fridge as the rice continues to absorb the liquid. Rice pudding can be served chilled. Alternatively, gently reheat the rice pudding, adding milk to adjust the consistency as needed.
author: Laila Ibrahim
